meta.unit_note: PropertyShark / CommercialCafe (Yardi) INDEX pages display rent at 1/12 of the true monthly rate (verified: 1738 Cordova St index '$0.16/SF/MO' vs detail page '$1.98/SF/MO NNN'; 856 S Vermont index '$0.23' vs detail '$2.75/SF/MO NNN'; 525 S Los Angeles St index $0.17 x 12 x 2,600 sf = $5,300 vs Craigslist ask $5,200). Rents marked 'derived x12' in notes were converted from the index display and should be confirmed on the detail page or with the broker. Rents marked 'verified' were read from a detail page or a Craigslist post that states the dollar figure.

gaps: LoopNet, Showcase.com and CityFeet (all CoStar) returned HTTP 403, so their inventory (usually the largest) is not represented; Crexi was not attempted within the call budget. A broker with CoStar access should re-run the search.

PropertyShark/CommercialCafe index pages display rent at 1/12 of the true monthly rate. Only 856 S Vermont ($2.75 NNN) and 1738 Cordova ($1.98 NNN) were confirmed on detail pages; every rent marked 'derived x12' still needs confirmation, and a few index values ($1.25/$1.26/$0.90 '/SF/YR', 3876 S Santa Fe) look mislabeled in a different way.
Most index listings do not state lease type (NNN/MG/FS) or physical features (roll-up door, power, yard, clear height); only the Craigslist posts and the two detail pages carry that data.

Four Craigslist leads give cross streets only, not a street address: the 18th St/Grand DTLA flex ($6,900), Pico & Western retail, Slauson/Western flex ($3,950) and the unaddressed $3,250 Central LA warehouse.

Westlake/MacArthur Park is thin: only one priced retail listing (1900 Beverly Blvd) and one oversized building (710 S Alvarado). Little Tokyo produced only mall retail. Historic Core inventory is small storefronts without roll-ups.
Vernon inventory under 8,000 sf was scarce on the pages fetched; most Vernon listings are 10,000-500,000 sf boxes, so the three Vernon entries are 7,000-9,500 sf.

No broker market page publishes a Koreatown-, Westlake- or East Hollywood-specific asking-rent range; the ranges given for those areas are observed from the listings themselves rather than from a market report.

Yardi 'average asking' figures (Vernon $14.14/sf/yr, DTLA retail $17.43/sf/yr) are simple averages of listed asks on those sites, not brokerage survey data; Kidder/Colliers/Lee figures are county- or region-wide, not submarket-specific.
Listings were captured on 2026-09-07; Craigslist posts are dated Aug 12 - Sep 7 2026 and Yardi listings show 'updated' dates from Jun-Aug 2026, but availability was not confirmed with any broker.
